name: Cape Schanck Boardwalk & Blowhole
address: Cape Schanck Rd, Cape Schanck VIC 3939
signature: A short clifftop boardwalk to the Peninsula's most dramatic headland — the blowhole, the lighthouse, and Bass Strait on three sides
editorNote:
The Cape Schanck boardwalk is the Peninsula's best short walk — a 30-minute return trip from the lighthouse carpark along a well-maintained elevated boardwalk to the cliff edge above Bushrangers Bay, passing the blowhole and ending at a viewing platform where Bass Strait surrounds you on three sides.

The blowhole activates on any swell above about 1.5ft — a deep bass thud followed by a column of spray from the basalt platform below. The viewing platform at the end has the kind of horizon-to-horizon ocean view that is disproportionately affecting for a 15-minute walk.

Accessible for most fitness levels. Part of the boardwalk is elevated on timber decking over the cliff edge — not suitable for those with severe vertigo. Can extend into the full Bushrangers Bay walk (45 min each way, steep) for a longer day.
whyWeGo: The best 30 minutes of walking on the Peninsula — the blowhole, the boardwalk, and the edge of the continent.
ifOnlyOneThing: Go on a day with a 2ft+ swell so the blowhole is active. The sound carries before you see it.
